question: Who enjoys distinguished fruit by orderly way?
premises: Orderly way governs all karma continuity.
inference: The agent who renounces fruit and follows orderly way enjoys distinguished fruit.
uncertainties: Compound segmentation of tatphalatyāgakṛtaṃ is interpretive.
plain_english: He enjoys distinguished fruit, made by abandoning fruit, through this orderly way, whoever has all karma continuity.
